staticBalance.model: At-rest force/moment balance with original muscle peaks, existing positive ground-contact points and an inscribed friction polygon. Capacity scale is a diagnostic variable, never applied to the body. Passive joint-limit reactions are omitted. This is not a physical recovery or dynamic stability proof.
staticBalance.interpretation: Independent substitution verifies feasible forces and torques below original at-rest peaks. Every solver report is inconsistent with nonzero dual residual, so these are feasible witnesses, not certified optima. Physical holds fail or remain nonstanding.

policy.provenanceCaveat: The copied runner reports the original contact-policy source hash. Its contact policy is replaced by the detached policy stored here. Trials with recompute absent use fixed torques; recompute trials update gravity and contact lever arms from actual observations. No engine handles or injected forces are supplied to the policy.
